entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I ordered a ClubFit jersey a while ago, and I feel terrible about this, but I only just tried it on for a big ride I had planned.
I'm sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it, it's beautiful. It's just the wrong size for me. It's way too tight in the shoulders. I was really hoping I could do an exchange or something. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I really could use the money back if an exchange isn't possible.
I understand completely, getting the right fit is crucial. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I just feel awful I waited so long to check. It's been a busy couple of months.
No problem at all, let's take a look. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like this jersey was delivered to you 83 days ago.
Oh no, is that too long? I was afraid of that.
Not at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return. So you're still well within the window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you right now.
Really? Oh, that is such a huge relief! You have no idea. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. You've been a wonderful help. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
